hooks.command: jq -c 'if ((.prompt // "") | test("^\\s*/flow:implement(\\s|$)")) then {"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "UserPromptSubmit", "additionalContext": "INSTRUCTION: The /flow:implement skill must always run inside a git worktree. Before invoking the skill, call EnterWorktree first to create an isolated worktree for this work. Do not run /flow:implement on a branch in the main repo checkout."}} else empty end'

jq -c 'if ((.prompt // "") | test("^\\s*/(flow:[a-z-]+|reflect)(\\s|$)")) then {"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "UserPromptSubmit", "additionalContext": "INSTRUCTION: Keep tone casual and brief everywhere in this workflow: chat, PR titles and descriptions, and code comments alike. Few words, plain language, no corporate-speak or padding. Only stop to explain something if it is a core or recurring concept worth remembering; let one-off ticket-specific values (a literal ARN, a CIDR, a magic number) pass without comment."}} else empty end'
